title: course 2 recital
system_instruction_addendum: COURSE 2 RECITAL ADDENDUM: Five transitions drawn from prior lessons. At least three different transition types are required to pass. State the score honestly.

tutor_speak.text: five transitions. perform each on your controller.
three different transition types are required to pass. if you nail it, course three unlocks.

recital_pool.prompt: perform a long blend — fade the crossfader from deck a to deck b.
perform an eq swap — cut deck a's low eq while you hold the crossfader steady.
perform a bassline swap — raise deck b's low eq to full on a beat one.
perform a filter fade — sweep deck a's filter knob to one extreme.
perform an echo-out — tap echo on deck a.
perform a drop swap — throw the crossfader fully to deck b on a downbeat.
perform a loop transition — tap loop in on deck a.

recital_outcomes.pass: 5 of 5 with {types} different transition types. course 3 unlocked.
recital_outcomes.fail: {score} of 5 with {types} different transition types. replay when you're ready.

hints.text: read the prompt at the top of the screen — perform that exact transition.
five prompts total, drawn from your transitions lessons.
press the prompted control or tap continue to begin.
